summary: An announcement about the ARPA Network Control Center at BBN. It was now staffed 24 hours a day, every day, so users should call about IMP, TIP or network problems at any time. It gives a new phone number and asks sites to post it near their IMPs.

eli5.summary: The helpdesk for the network is now open all day and night, and it has a new phone number. People are asked to stick it near their machines.

questions: who to call for arpanet problems
